headlines.description: — Artem Zub and Jordan Spence’s first-period goals, scored 15 seconds apart, were enough to lead the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 win over the struggling Vancouver Canucks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators snap losing skid with 2-1 win over struggling Canucks

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored the deciding goal in the shootout and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 2-1 on Tuesday night for their 11th straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kucherov scores deciding shootout goal as Lightning beat Penguins 2-1 for 11th straight win

headlines.description: — Connor McMichael scored with 37.6 seconds remaining in overtime to lift the Washington Capitals to a 3-2 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Capitals rally with 2 in the third, then beat Montreal 3-2 on McMichael's goal in OT

events.name: Calgary Flames at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Boone Jenner scored with 1:34 remaining, Charlie Coyle had two goals and an assist, and Rick Bowness won his debut as Columbus' coach as the Blue Jackets defeated the Calgary Flames 5-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jenner's goal propels Blue Jackets to 5-3 win over Flames in Bowness' debut as coach

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Jeremy Swayman stopped 24 shots for his first shutout of the season, and the Boston Bruins beat the Detroit Red Wings 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Swayman stops 24 shots for 1st shutout of season as Bruins beat Red Wings 3-0

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Joel Hofer made 33 saves as the St. Louis Blues snapped a three-game losing streak by shutting out the Carolina Hurricanes 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues snap 3-game skid with 3-0 win over Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Roman Josi scored his second goal of the game at 3:43 of overtime, and the Nashville Predators beat the Edmonton Oilers 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josi scores twice, including winner in OT as Predators beat Oilers 4-3

events.name: New York Islanders at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Adam Lowry and Kyle Connor each had a goal and an assist, and the Winnipeg Jets beat the New York Islanders 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowry, Connor each have goal and assist as Jets beat Islanders 5-4 for their 3rd straight win

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Dylan Guenther had two goals and an assist, Jack McBain added a goal and two assists, and the Utah Mammoth beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guenther scores 2 goals as Mammoth beat Maple Leafs 6-1

headlines.description: — Chris Kreider and Beckett Sennecke scored goals, Lukas Dostal survived a barrage of shots in the final minutes, and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Dallas Stars 3-1 on Tuesday night to snap a nine-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lukas Dostal has 24 saves as Ducks beat Stars 3-1 to snap nine-game skid
